messages:
alex: hey all, first day trouble. I accepted the org invite but there are two accounts showing up: my old personal `alexdev` (has my work email attached) and the new `alex.work` we gave for onboarding. I accepted on alexdev and now cloning `services/payments` returns 403. anyone who deals with invite/account merges?

devex: welcome @alex! quick question: which GH username did you accept the invite with? and can you paste the exact git error?

alex: accepted on alexdev. git error is:```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/services-payments.git
Cloning into 'services-payments'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

ida-identity: this is a common duplicate-account + SSO problem. If the org sees alexdev as an outside collaborator and alex.work as pending, SAML/SCIM flows can get confused. Did you make the work email primary on alexdev?

alex: work email is present but not primary on alexdev. I also haven't set 2FA on either account yet.

chris-it: two things to try: (1) make the work email primary on the account you want to use, (2) enable 2FA. Also check if there's an outstanding team invite (bell icon).

github-bot: Org invitation resent to alex.work (alex@redwood.ai) by ida-identity.

devex: alex, if you prefer to use the new `alex.work` profile we'll resend to that username and you can accept. If you want to keep `alexdev`, make the work email primary and we'll convert you to a Member and add you to the right teams.

alex: i want to keep alexdev (it has my commit history). making work email primary now and enabling 2FA.

ida-identity: once 2FA + primary email are set, please try the SAML authorize flow on the org page (there should be a blue "Authorize SAML SSO" button). Also note: if you use HTTPS and have a cached personal PAT, pushes/clones will still 403. Consider switching to SSH or clearing the credential helper.

alex: aha i do have a cached PAT from years ago. here's how i removed it on macOS:```bash
printf "protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n" | git credential-osxkeychain erase
```
I switched remote to SSH and added my SSH key to GitHub. Trying clone again.

github-bot: SAML SSO authorization requested for alexdev by alex.

alex: after making the work email primary, enabling 2FA, authorizing SSO, and removing old PAT, clone works! :tada: Thanks.

maria-eng: great—i've added you to the "payments" team and set repo write perms. welcome to eng-payments @alex. If you hit any repo-level 403s, ping me and include `git remote -v` and `gh whoami`.

devex: adding a short onboarding note: if you have multiple GH accounts, either consolidate or accept invites on the profile you want; make work email primary, enable 2FA, authorize SAML, and prefer SSH (or ensure credential helper points at the right token).

alex: thanks everyone, that was fast. excited to get started! :rocket:
